---
title: "Skills"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('data/skills.yaml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

for section in data['skills']:
    print(f"## {section['category']}\n")
    for item in section['items']:
        print(f"- {item}")
    print()
```
